name: hebrewTranslator
description: Auto-detects Hebrew prompts, translates to English, and requests Hebrew responses
author: Hebrew Token Saver

capabilities.translation: Hebrew to English via MyMemory API

pi.dev.enable: Auto-enabled when skill is in skills directory

workflow.description: Check if input contains Hebrew characters (≥20% Hebrew)
Call MyMemory API to translate Hebrew → English
Add '. Important! Reply in Hebrew' to translated prompt
Send final prompt to configured LLM
LLM's Hebrew response is returned to user

examples.finalPrompt: How to make halva? . Important! Reply in Hebrew

examples.translated: What is the capital of France?
examples.finalPrompt: What is the capital of France? . Important! Reply in Hebrew
